title: 18th Skill Development Programme on Pharmacovigilance of Medical Products through Webinar from 13-17th September 2021
bodyHtml:
Applications are invited for the Skill Development Programme from Physicians, Medical/Pharmacy Students, Academicians, Research Scholars, Industry Professionals and other Healthcare Professionals.

IPC NCC-PvPI is pleased to invite interested participants for the upcoming Virtual Skill Development Programme on Pharmacovigilance for Medical Products (SDP 2021)

Date: 13th-17th September 2021.

Last date of Registration: 2 September 2021

For more Details: Website: https://www.ipc.gov.in/mandates/pvpi/pharmacovigilance-skill-development-programme.html

Email: sdp.nccpvpi@gmail.com
